title: Powerful Legs
description: Lower body with 1.5 squats, reverse lunges and hip thrusts, followed by a dynamic core finisher

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Lower down, rise halfway, lower again, then rise all the way

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step back, lower the knee

exercises.name: Floor hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, lift the hips, squeeze the glutes

exercises.name: Bicycle crunches
exercises.instructions: Elbow to opposite knee alternating, leg extended

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, quick alternating kicks

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
